cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded travel card with Scapia rewarding hotel and airline bookings with accelerated points, while offering travel vouchers and lifestyle perks.

eligibility: Spend ₹10,000 for Visa and ₹15,000 for RuPay in a billing cycle.

loungeRows.name: Domestic Lounges
loungeRows.eligibility: A total combined monthly spend of ₹20,000 across both VIsa and Rupay cards, or on a single card, unlocks domestic lounge access and airport privileges.
